issues.where: all leaves and the bud of the hero plant
issues.what: the thick white frost rim and the frost crystals that cover the leaves in -a are almost gone; the leaves read as plain dark green with only a faint pale edge, so the backlit frosted look is lost
issues.fix: bring back the dense white frost fringe on every leaf edge and bract tip, and the frost speckle across the leaf faces, lit from behind by the sun as in -a

issues.where: the hero plant's leaf layout, lower half of frame
issues.what: the large frosted lower-left leaf, the lower-right leaf and the bottom leaf pair seen in -a are missing; -b has a different set of leaves (a small drooping leaf at the left, a large flat leaf to the right of the stem) and empty space at the bottom of the frame
issues.fix: rebuild the leaf layout of -a: upper leaf pair under the bud, a large frosted leaf to the right at mid height, a large leaf lower left, and leaves filling the bottom edge

issues.where: region 5, the field behind the plant, and the whole lower background
issues.what: the field is lifted and washed out to a flat pale grey-teal with milky blacks and little contrast; in -a it is deep, dark green with real shadow and rim-lit leaves
issues.fix: darken the field and deepen its blacks, put back the green saturation and the contrast between leaves, keep the fog only as a soft veil that grows with distance

issues.what: the bud in -b is bigger, sits higher and slightly right, and is spikier and more open with long thin bracts; -a's bud is a tighter rounded cluster with frosted bract tips; the frost on the bract edges is nearly missing
issues.fix: make the bud smaller and tighter, place it where it is in -a, and frost the bract tips

issues.where: region 2, the stem and its hairs
issues.what: the stem in -b is a straight, uniformly thick dark column with short dull hairs; in -a it is thinner, slightly curved, with bright backlit hairs and side branches to each leaf
issues.fix: thin and curve the stem slightly, add the leaf branches, and backlight the hairs so they glow

issues.where: region 6, the far background at the skyline
issues.what: the far plants in -b are flat, dark silhouettes with flat heads that stand up sharply against the sky, including a cluster on the right that is not in -a; in -a they fade softly into the fog, keep some green and have rounded buds
issues.fix: fade the far plants into the haze with distance, soften their edges, give them rounded buds and remove the extra dark cluster at the right

issues.where: the background plants on both sides
issues.what: the near background plants in -a (clear buds at left and right, at mid height) are replaced by faint thin stalks; the layering of near, middle and far plants is lost
issues.fix: put back the mid-distance plants with visible buds at the left and right, darker and sharper than the far ones

issues.what: the sky in -b is a cooler blue-grey; -a's sky is a warmer, lighter neutral grey
issues.fix: warm the sky slightly and lift it toward the neutral pale grey of -a

issues.where: region 4, the sun and the sky round it
issues.what: the sun in -b sits a little further right and higher, and its warm peach halo is a bit smaller and weaker than in -a
issues.fix: move the sun slightly left and down to its place in -a and widen the warm halo around it
